001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Control-IQ's state for one 5-minute algorithm cycle: its glucose estimate and prediction,
009 * net IOB, TDI estimate, correction factor, target, the programmed basal it starts from, and
010 * what it commands (the hypoglycemia brake, the cycle's insulin and the increase above profile).
011 * Written every ~300 s on t:slim X2 and Mobi, including with Control-IQ off and with no CGM,
012 * directly before opcode 327 in the same second and before the next {@link BasalDeliveryHistoryLog}
013 * (about 30 s later on Mobi, about 90 s on the X2).
014 *
015 * <p>Evidence, from about 11,000 records in 10 pump datasets: {@link #getProgrammedBasalRate()} matches
016 * the next BasalDelivery's programmed rate in 99.5%; {@link #getHypoBrake()} is the stated function
017 * of {@link #getPredictedGlucoseX100()} in 96-100% per dataset; with Control-IQ on,
018 * {@link #getCycleInsulinMilliunits()} is the next BasalDelivery's algorithm rate over 12 (plus any
019 * automatic correction bolus) in 98-99%. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/146.
020 *
021 * <p>These are pump-internal Control-IQ values. Do not use them for dosing or as the IOB.
022 *
023 * <p>The class name is provisional: opcode 227 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
024 * app's history log list. {@link #getSleepRamp()} is exposed raw because its meaning is unknown.
025 */
026@HistoryLogProps(
027    opCode = 227,
028    displayName = "Control-IQ Cycle"
029)
030public class ControlIQCycleHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
031
032    private int basalIncreaseMilliunits;
033    private int cycleInsulinMilliunits;
034    private int predictedGlucoseX100;
035    private int programmedBasalRate;
036    private int netIobMilliunits;
037    private int glucoseEstimate;
038    private int correctionFactor;
039    private int tdiEstimate;
040    private int hypoBrake;
041    private int sleepRamp;
042    private int upperTarget;
043
044    public ControlIQCycleHistoryLog() {}
045    public ControlIQCycleHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int basalIncreaseMilliunits, int cycleInsulinMilliunits, int predictedGlucoseX100, int programmedBasalRate, int netIobMilliunits, int glucoseEstimate, int correctionFactor, int tdiEstimate, int hypoBrake, int sleepRamp, int upperTarget) {
046        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
047        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, basalIncreaseMilliunits, cycleInsulinMilliunits, predictedGlucoseX100, programmedBasalRate, netIobMilliunits, glucoseEstimate, correctionFactor, tdiEstimate, hypoBrake, sleepRamp, upperTarget);
048        this.basalIncreaseMilliunits = basalIncreaseMilliunits;
049        this.cycleInsulinMilliunits = cycleInsulinMilliunits;
050        this.predictedGlucoseX100 = predictedGlucoseX100;
051        this.programmedBasalRate = programmedBasalRate;
052        this.netIobMilliunits = netIobMilliunits;
053        this.glucoseEstimate = glucoseEstimate;
054        this.correctionFactor = correctionFactor;
055        this.tdiEstimate = tdiEstimate;
056        this.hypoBrake = hypoBrake;
057        this.sleepRamp = sleepRamp;
058        this.upperTarget = upperTarget;
059    }
060
061    public int typeId() {
062        return 227;
063    }
064
065    /**
066     * <table border="1">
067     * <caption>Parsed fields for ControlIQCycleHistoryLog:</caption>
068     * <tr><td><code>basalIncreaseMilliunits</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
069     * <tr><td><code>cycleInsulinMilliunits</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
070     * <tr><td><code>predictedGlucoseX100</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
071     * <tr><td><code>programmedBasalRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
072     * <tr><td><code>netIobMilliunits</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
073     * <tr><td><code>glucoseEstimate</code></td><td><code>raw[20] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
074     * <tr><td><code>correctionFactor</code></td><td><code>raw[21] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
075     * <tr><td><code>tdiEstimate</code></td><td><code>raw[22] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
076     * <tr><td><code>hypoBrake</code></td><td><code>raw[23] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
077     * <tr><td><code>sleepRamp</code></td><td><code>raw[24] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
078     * <tr><td><code>upperTarget</code></td><td><code>raw[25] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
079     * </table>
080     */
081    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
082        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
083        this.cargo = raw;
084        parseBase(raw);
085        this.basalIncreaseMilliunits = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
086        this.cycleInsulinMilliunits = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
087        this.predictedGlucoseX100 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
088        this.programmedBasalRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
089        this.netIobMilliunits = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
090        this.glucoseEstimate = raw[20] & 0xFF;
091        this.correctionFactor = raw[21] & 0xFF;
092        this.tdiEstimate = raw[22] & 0xFF;
093        this.hypoBrake = raw[23] & 0xFF;
094        this.sleepRamp = raw[24] & 0xFF;
095        this.upperTarget = raw[25] & 0xFF;
096    }
097
098    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int basalIncreaseMilliunits, int cycleInsulinMilliunits, int predictedGlucoseX100, int programmedBasalRate, int netIobMilliunits, int glucoseEstimate, int correctionFactor, int tdiEstimate, int hypoBrake, int sleepRamp, int upperTarget) {
099        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
100            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(227, 0),
101            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
102            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
103            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(basalIncreaseMilliunits),
104            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(cycleInsulinMilliunits),
105            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(predictedGlucoseX100),
106            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(programmedBasalRate),
107            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(netIobMilliunits),
108            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(glucoseEstimate),
109            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(correctionFactor),
110            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(tdiEstimate),
111            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(hypoBrake),
112            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(sleepRamp),
113            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(upperTarget)));
114    }
115
116    /**
117     * floor(max(0, algorithmRate - profileBasalRate) / 12) for the next
118     * {@link BasalDeliveryHistoryLog}. Nonzero only when Control-IQ raises basal above the profile
119     * (never with Control-IQ off).
120     *
121     * @return the cycle's basal increase above the profile rate, in milliunits per 5 minutes
122     */
123    public int getBasalIncreaseMilliunits() {
124        return basalIncreaseMilliunits;
125    }
126
127    /**
128     * With Control-IQ on: floor(algorithmRate / 12) for the next {@link BasalDeliveryHistoryLog},
129     * plus the requested amount of a Control-IQ automatic correction bolus started in this cycle.
130     * With Control-IQ off: close to floor(programmedBasalRate / 12 * hypoBrakeFraction) (81-99% of
131     * records on three Mobis), which the pump then does not deliver.
132     *
133     * @return the insulin the algorithm computes for this cycle, in milliunits
134     */
135    public int getCycleInsulinMilliunits() {
136        return cycleInsulinMilliunits;
137    }
138
139    /**
140     * Predicted glucose x100, floored at 2000. Roughly the glucose estimate plus 20 minutes of the
141     * recent CGM trend, minus an insulin effect; the exact prediction horizon is not confirmed.
142     *
143     * @return the predicted glucose in mg/dL x 100
144     */
145    public int getPredictedGlucoseX100() {
146        return predictedGlucoseX100;
147    }
148
149    /**
150     * @return {@link #getPredictedGlucoseX100()} in mg/dL
151     */
152    public double getPredictedGlucoseMgdl() {
153        return predictedGlucoseX100 / 100.0;
154    }
155
156    /**
157     * The active temp rate if one is running, else the profile rate; the profile rate while
158     * suspended. Capped at 3000. On Control-IQ v7.6 Mobi firmware this is the profile rate even
159     * during a temp rate.
160     *
161     * @return the programmed basal rate, in milliunits/hr
162     */
163    public int getProgrammedBasalRate() {
164        return programmedBasalRate;
165    }
166
167    /**
168     * Not the IOB the pump displays. Fits boluses plus (delivered - programmed) basal through a
169     * two-compartment curve (1 + t/tau) * e^(-t/tau) with tau = 34 minutes, floored at 0
170     * (r 0.97-0.9998 in 8 datasets).
171     *
172     * @return the algorithm's net insulin on board, in milliunits
173     */
174    public int getNetIobMilliunits() {
175        return netIobMilliunits;
176    }
177
178    /**
179     * Tracks the latest CGM reading (r 0.997-0.998, usually 1 mg/dL below it) and saturates at 255.
180     * With no CGM paired to the pump it stays near a fixed value.
181     *
182     * @return the algorithm's current glucose estimate, in mg/dL
183     */
184    public int getGlucoseEstimate() {
185        return glucoseEstimate;
186    }
187
188    /**
189     * min(floor(1800 / TDI estimate), profile correction factor) in 2024-2026 data; 1500 instead of
190     * 1800 in the 2022 records and part of 2023.
191     *
192     * @return the correction factor the algorithm uses, in mg/dL per unit
193     */
194    public int getCorrectionFactor() {
195        return correctionFactor;
196    }
197
198    /**
199     * The integer part of the estimate in the AATdiEstChange record (opcode 332) that the Mobi writes
200     * hourly in the same second, just before this record.
201     *
202     * @return the total daily insulin estimate, in whole units per day
203     */
204    public int getTdiEstimate() {
205        return tdiEstimate;
206    }
207
208    /**
209     * floor(200 / (1 + 2.5 * r)) for predicted glucose G = {@link #getPredictedGlucoseMgdl()} &gt;= 70,
210     * and 0 below 70, where r = 10 * f^2 when f = 1.509 * (ln(G)^1.084 - 5.381) is negative and 0
211     * otherwise (Kovatchev's low-BG risk, zero at 112.5 mg/dL). 200 means no attenuation.
212     *
213     * @return the hypoglycemia brake factor, 0-200
214     */
215    public int getHypoBrake() {
216        return hypoBrake;
217    }
218
219    /**
220     * @return {@link #getHypoBrake()} as a fraction, 0.0 (full brake) to 1.0 (none)
221     */
222    public double getHypoBrakeFraction() {
223        return hypoBrake / 200.0;
224    }
225
226    /**
227     * 0 outside sleep. In sleep mode it rises by 3 or 4 per cycle (40 per hour) to 200 over five
228     * hours; after sleep ends it falls by 4-5 per cycle. Meaning unknown.
229     *
230     * @return raw uint8 at offset 24
231     */
232    public int getSleepRamp() {
233        return sleepRamp;
234    }
235
236    /**
237     * 160 in normal and exercise mode and 120 in sleep mode, moving between them over about
238     * 40-90 minutes after a mode change.
239     *
240     * @return the upper bound of the Control-IQ target range, in mg/dL
241     */
242    public int getUpperTarget() {
243        return upperTarget;
244    }
245}
